correctness.rationale: Closure means choosing whole reverse-complement orbits. Testing every ordered overlap within an orbit and between compatible orbits gives a bijection between admissible literal codebooks and cliques, with codebook cardinality equal to the sum of orbit sizes. Positive weights imply every maximizer is inclusion-maximal. The independently written integer enumeration retained all ties and returned M=(2,1,0,1,0,2,0,5,2,14,10,42), T=(1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2,4,6,96,1134) for n=1,...,12. The empty clique counts once when there are no eligible orbits, and n=1 has no proper nonempty overlap. All 1134 length-12 optima have 16 pairs; weight 42 then forces 10 fixed words. Separately, direct checks of the displayed length-12 witness found 42 distinct binary words, closure, 10 fixed words, and zero prohibited matches in 19404 ordered prefix/suffix comparisons.
residual_risks: Finite exhaustive result only; no upper bound for n>12 is established by this census.
